naming_note: 'KINE-ADL BE-UJI' was resolved to the Mendeley Data record 10.17632/8mf4y2srgh.4.  No artefact is published under that exact string; the record's title is 'KINE-ADL BE-UJI: Kinematics of human hand dataset for feeding and cooking tasks'.  The audit reports what exists and does not invent a release

exact_18_anatomical_angles.source: MOVMUS-UJI guide v2.1 Table 4, ANGLES block

acquisition_hardware.value: CyberGlove II (right) and CyberGlove III (left) instrumented gloves, 18 strain gauges each

value.transform: angle = (raw - raw_at_reference_posture) x gain, with additional modelled cross-coupling terms

specific_terms_read_from_the_code.CMC1_F: 2-term mix of the CMC1 flexion and abduction gauges
specific_terms_read_from_the_code.CMC1_A: the transpose mix of the same two gauges
specific_terms_read_from_the_code.MCP2-3_A: linear + quadratic + interaction in the MCP2 and MCP3 flexion gauges
specific_terms_read_from_the_code.DIP2..DIP5: 0.87/0.79/0.73/0.84 x PIP - offset, floored at 0 for the 18-sensor glove; a separate gain column for the 22-sensor glove

value.answer: GLOBAL PER GLOVE UNIT, not per subject
value.evidence: the calibration protocol is titled 'across-subject calibration'; gains_identification.m hard-codes the UJI group's own glove gains in per-model, per-hand vectors and comments 'Gains values should be completed with own glove gains'

value.definition: the mean of a recorded REFERENCE posture: hands resting flat on the table, fingers and thumb close together, middle fingers aligned with the forearms
value.kind: RECORDED REFERENCE POSTURE (not a nominal anatomical zero)
value.implication: legitimate, but the zero is session-dependent, so any API record must name the reference posture in words - which the guide does

value.sign_criteria: PIP(2-5)_F, IP1_F, CMC1_F, MCP(1-5)_F, WR_F: Flexion+/Extension-;  MCP(2-3, 3-4, 4-5)_A: separated+/together-;  PalmArch: Flexion+/Extension-;  CMC1_A: Abduction+/Adduction-;  WR_A: ulnar deviation+/radial-
value.cross_check: the released KIN-MUS block corroborates every criterion in the direction that matters

value.note: the cited calibration paper reports them, but the per-recording residuals are not distributed with the data

hand_size_dependence_discussed.value: YES - explicitly: removed outliers are attributed to 'a poor fit of these gauges for a specific subject ... who had a small hand length'

cross_talk_discussed.value: YES, and modelled, not merely acknowledged

value.answer: INFERRED - computed from PIP, never measured
value.corroborating_source: the group published a dedicated dataset titled 'Problems Using Data Gloves with Strain Gauges to Measure Distal Interphalangeal Joints' Kinematics' with static-posture controls that vary PIP and DIP independently

value.title: KINE-ADL BE-UJI: Kinematics of human hand dataset for feeding and cooking tasks

value.what_is_UNCERTAIN_for_KINE_ADL: the audited record describes activities and objects; whether it carries the same task/action annotation layers as MOVMUS is not established from the retrievable metadata

value.segment-level kinematics: POSE-MOSTLY-SUFFICIENT once a segmentation is agreed
value.verdict: CONDITIONAL - segmentation must be established first

continuous_trajectories.value: YES - '1160 continuous calibrated recordings taken at 100Hz ... with filtered signal'

empirical_status: the corpus was NOT downloaded (bounded-download rule).  The record metadata and the shared angle pipeline were verified; the angle tables were not measured.  No KIN-MUS measurement is reported here as a KINE-ADL measurement
minimum_evidence_to_promote: confirm its channel list and column order against the documented 18
